summary: ansible.posix firewalld changed forward, masquerade and icmp_block_inversion options from strings to booleans.
questions: What type is the masquerade option in ansible.posix.firewalld now?
Why does firewalld forward: 'yes' behave differently?

answer_card.title: firewalld options are now booleans
answer_card.answer_md: In ansible.posix (Ansible 12.0.0), the `firewalld` module options `forward`, `masquerade` and `icmp_block_inversion` changed type from **str to bool**.
